summary.text: John Haste is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 36 who took office in November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Rick Larsen as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Haste was born in Arkansas and raised in Tennessee, and he attended the University of Tennessee at Martin.
He worked as a senior vice president in the home furnishings industry and has served as vice chair and chair of the Oklahoma State University Medical Authority and Trust.
Haste assumed office on November 21, 2018, and defeated Philip Weiland in the June 16, 2026 Republican primary.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Appropriations Committee and a member of the Health and Human Services Committee, the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances, the Committee on Pandemic Relief Funding, and the Oversight Committee for the Legislative Office of Fiscal Transparency.
